    Sample size for a target OR precision, binary predictor

    n_precision_binary_po.Rd

    Computes the total sample size n needed so that the confidence interval for the odds ratio has a target ratio of upper to lower limit, for a binary predictor in a proportional-odds model. Since the Fisher information scales linearly with n, the SE at any n is SE(n0) * sqrt(n0 / n) exactly (for either method); the fit is done once at n0 and rescaled analytically.

    n_precision_binary_po(
  pc,
  OR = NULL,
  pe = NULL,
  rr = NULL,
  ratio_UL,
  r = 1,
  conf = 0.95,
  method = c("ologit", "whitehead"),
  n0 = 1000
)

    Arguments

    pc

    Control-arm category probabilities (sum to 1).

    OR, pe, rr

    Exactly one, defining the experimental arm; see build_arm_probs().

    ratio_UL

    Target ratio of the upper to lower confidence limit for the OR.

    r

    Allocation ratio, treatment:control.

    conf

    Confidence level for the reported interval.

    method

    "ologit" (default; exact MLE) or "whitehead" (delta-method approximation).

    n0

    Sample size at which the one-time reference fit is done before rescaling; the default is large enough that further increases do not change the result.

    Value

    A list with elements n, conf, OR, method, lci_or, uci_or.

    Examples

    pc <- c(0.15, 0.10, 0.10, 0.10, 0.10, 0.45)
n_precision_binary_po(pc, OR = 2, ratio_UL = 3, method = "whitehead")
#> $n
#> [1] 164
#> 
#> $conf
#> [1] 0.95
#> 
#> $OR
#> [1] 2
#> 
#> $method
#> [1] "whitehead"
#> 
#> $lci_or
#> [1] 1.154701
#> 
#> $uci_or
#> [1] 3.464102
#> 
n_precision_binary_po(pc, OR = 2, ratio_UL = 3, method = "ologit")
#> $n
#> [1] 169
#> 
#> $conf
#> [1] 0.95
#> 
#> $OR
#> [1] 2
#> 
#> $method
#> [1] "ologit"
#> 
#> $lci_or
#> [1] 1.1547
#> 
#> $uci_or
#> [1] 3.464101
#>
